page: Amazon Web Services m7i.12xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features an Intel Xeon 8488C processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance allocates 48 dedicated virtual cores across 24 physical cores with two threads per core. Memory capacity totals 192 GB of high-speed DDR5 RAM at 5 GHz, maintaining a balanced 1:4 allocation ratio of 4 GB memory per vCPU. Hardware features include 105 MB of L3 cache alongside support for Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 vector instruction sets.

The instance delivers strong compute performance across standard benchmark suites, including a PassMark CPU score of 63,240.19 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 16,969.0. It demonstrates high efficiency in instruction-heavy tasks, recording 51,341.08 in cryptographic operations and 39,723.0 in Clang code compilation. In database operations, the server achieved strong ratings with 23,984.46 in PassMark tests and 63.12 million operations per second in Redis SET throughput. For machine learning tasks, AMX acceleration assists in achieving 351.99 tokens per second on text generation using small 135M models.

Storage configuration on m7i.12xlarge requires external network-attached volumes, as no local NVMe storage is bundled with the instance. Networking capacity provides a baseline bandwidth of 19 Gbps, supporting stable throughput for distributed applications. Without local storage and without dedicated hardware accelerators such as GPUs, system cost efficiency centers on balanced compute density and CPU-level matrix acceleration for general workloads.

The resource profile aligns with enterprise-tier web serving, continuous integration pipelines, large relational databases, in-memory caches, and moderate CPU-based machine learning inference. Workloads needing extreme local I/O performance will require attached EBS storage optimization to complement the available compute and memory density.
description: Amazon Web Services m7i.12xlarge is a general-purpose Nitro-based cloud instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8488C processor clocked at 3.2 GHz. The instance delivers 48 dedicated vCPUs from 24 physical cores paired with 192 GB of DDR5 memory at 5 GHz, preserving a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It includes advanced architectural extensions such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX, which drive high execution efficiency across integer, cryptographic, and lightweight matrix inference workloads. Benchmark results show strong performance across PassMark CPU evaluations, multi-threaded Clang compilation, and in-memory key-value processing, yielding 63.12 million operations per second in Redis SET operations. The m7i.12xlarge contains no integrated local storage and no GPU hardware, utilizing a 19 Gbps network baseline for connected infrastructure and remote volumes. This instance profile is suited for medium-to-large relational databases, distributed caching layers, application backend servers, containerized microservices, and CPU-driven machine learning inferencing.
